topic: How are link budgets affected when prioritizing high-revenue services versus navigation safety margins in dynamic scheduling?
consensus_response: Prioritizing high-revenue services over navigation safety margins reduces link margin, increases interference, and causes resource blocking. Adaptive modulation, coding schemes, and beamforming techniques can mitigate these effects by optimizing capacity allocation and enhancing spatial reuse. Effective admission control and traffic engineering are crucial to balance revenue-generating and safety-related services.
reference_context: QoS provisioning in satellite and terrestrial networks requires managing available capacity, link characteristics, and traffic requirements to ensure reliable communication.
